candidats.description: 221214-N-DK042-2065 SAN DIEGO (Dec. 14, 2022) Equipment Operator 2nd Class Vanessa Leon, attached to Amphibious Construction Battalion (ACB) 1, transports the NASA Artemis I Orion spacecraft out of the well deck of amphibious transport dock USS Portland (LPD 27) onboard Naval Base San Diego, Dec. 14, 2022. Portland, along with Independence-variant littoral combat ship USS Montgomery (LCS 8), supported the spacecraft recovery while underway in U.S. 3rd Fleet.
